SUBMISSIONS!!

  • To start, scan using a mobile device 📱. Id recommend the notes app or preview app!! You can also just take pictures, though they might be a bit blurrier 📸!!
  • Next, put these in a google doc, either by airdropping the pictures to a laptop or computer, or putting them in the google docs app!
  • Next, simply press share up top, switch access to ‘anyone with link’, and copy the link!!
  • Lastly, just paste this link and message it to me on discord (@thatone37.2), pinterest (@thatone3729) or via email (@thatone37.29@gmail.com)

In your message, please include:

  1. The socials you’d like cited
  2. Whatever name you’d like in the title [blank’s sketchbook] (a silly nickname, whatever you usually g0 by online!!)
  3. Trigger warnings!! Very important!! Warn for blood, gore, body horror, injuries, eye straining visuals, nudity, anything sexual, etc!! (please keep things sfw though! Artistic nudity is okay, and some suggestive drawings are alright, but please keep it mild!!)
  4. Next, tags!! Tag fandoms, the type of media you used, vibe, etc!!

thank you so much for reading all of this!! and thank you if you've even considered submitting, it seriously means so much to me to see people sharing and encouraging eachother through my silly little passion project 🤍
